title: CCNA Exam Traps: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: The CCNA exam is full of traps. Most come down to numbers you should know cold. Let's learn the key ones.

lines.t: The exam is full of traps

scenes.heading: Numbers to know cold
scenes.narration: Learn these defaults. O S P F dead time is forty seconds. E I G R P hold is fifteen seconds. S T P uses two, twenty and fifteen. M A C entries age out after three hundred seconds.

scenes.heading: The airport checkpoint
scenes.narration: A few habits pay off on exam day. Read the whole question, because the trap is often in the last line. Eliminate the answers that are clearly wrong first. Don't spend too long on any one question. Learn the defaults, since many questions are just defaults.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva the exam lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Learn the default timers. Read the whole question. Eliminate, then guess. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva the exam lab.
